question: What meditative action follows the placement of the six-limb rite on the body?
premises: The six-limb rite is applied beginning with the thumb and other parts.
After this placement, the goddess is to be meditated upon.
inference: After performing the six-limb placement from the thumb onward, one should meditate on the goddess.
plain_english: After placing the six limbs beginning with the thumb, one should again meditate on the goddess.
